skills.title: SDK protocol and transaction safety
skills.description: Use for changes to ABIs, addresses, accounting or rounding math, chain or account checks, approvals, signatures, routing, simulation or composed transaction flows: pinned protocol sources, funds and authority across a complete caller flow, and replay or ordering attacks.

skills.title: SDK integrator compatibility and architecture
skills.description: Use for changes to public behavior, defaults, signatures, exports, state transport, dependencies, package boundaries or deprecations: what existing integrators see, layer ownership, stateless prepare/sign/build, and the deprecation lifecycle.

skills.title: SDK implementation and failure behavior
skills.description: Use for changes to .ts code: types and units, input mutation, typed errors and causes, promises, optional lookups, fallback, generated sources, secrets and injection.

skills.title: SDK tests and documentation
skills.description: Use for changes to tests, JSDoc, examples or Markdown, and for public behavior that needs them: discriminating assertions, the pure, transport-mock or pinned-fork boundary, canonical JSDoc, and active docs and references.

skills.title: SDK CI, release and automation integrity
skills.description: Use for changes to workflows, CI scripts, package manifests, lockfiles, changesets, install or publish settings, review criteria and agent instructions: semver and changesets, dependency trust, workflow trust and publication, and instruction integrity.
